rows.note: This is the all-purpose pattern for saying that someone completes a task or activity.

example.english: I’ll finish my homework before I go out to play.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3 sin1 ceot1 heoi3 waan2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the end or conclusion of something.

example.english: The finish of this movie is quite moving.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 git3 mei5 gei2 gam2 jan4

rows.note: Use 完 when an event, show, meeting, or period itself comes to an end, often with 咗.

example.english: The show has reached its finish, so we can leave now.
example.jyutping: tou3 kek6 jyun4 zo2 ngo5 dei6 sin1 zau2

rows.note: Use this for the protective coating itself, rather than for its appearance or quality.

example.english: This metal rack needs a protective finish to prevent rust.
example.traditional: 呢件鐵架要加一層防鏽塗層。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 tit3 gaa2 jiu3 gaa1 jat1 cang4 fong4 sau3 tou4 cang4

rows.note: Use this for added polish or careful elaboration, especially in writing or presentation.

example.english: The finish given to this report makes it read much more smoothly.
example.traditional: 呢篇報告經過潤色之後，讀起上嚟順好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 bou3 gou3 ging1 gwo3 jeon6 sik1 zi1 hau6 duk6 hei2 soeng6 lei4 seon6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use 搞垮 when finishing means ruining or bringing down a person, career, organization, or plan.

example.english: That financial crisis was enough to finish the company off.
example.traditional: 場金融風暴搞垮咗間公司。
example.jyutping: coeng4 gam1 jung4 fung1 bou6 gaau2 kwaa1 zo2 gaan1 gung1 si1

rows.note: Use this technical textile term for processes that give cloth its final properties or appearance.

example.english: After the fabric received its finish, its water resistance improved a lot.
example.traditional: 呢批布做完後整理之後，防水性能好咗好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 bou3 zou6 jyun4 hau6 zing2 lei5 zi1 hau6 fong4 seoi2 sing3 nang4 hou2 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use 髹油 for applying a paint or varnish finish to a surface rather than for completing a task.

example.english: The painter will finish the door with a coat of varnish.
example.jyutping: go3 si1 fu2 bong1 ngo5 sin3 mun4 jau1 jau4
